name: MAGFest schedule
description: Full-screen schedule in the Super MAGFest 2027 style from schedule.magfest.net. With rooms set: the current session in each room with a progress bar, up next, and a short list of what's later. With no rooms: the schedule by itself, paging through what's on now and coming up. Cached on the device, so it keeps working offline.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: Rooms to show, by name as on the schedule ("Panels 1 (Cherry Blossom Ballroom)"), the name without the part in brackets ("Panels 1"), or location ID. Empty shows the whole schedule.

tracks.title: Only these tracks
tracks.description: Show only sessions in at least one of these tracks (name or ID). Empty shows every track.

excludeTracks.title: Hide these tracks
excludeTracks.description: Hide sessions in any of these tracks (name or ID).

abbreviate.title: Abbreviate session names
abbreviate.description: Shorten session names in the schedule lists to at most this many characters. 0 = no limit (long names are cut to fit the line).

title.title: Title
title.description: Heading. Empty: the room name for one room, "Now and next" for several, "Schedule" for no rooms.

lookaheadHours.title: Look ahead (hours)
lookaheadHours.description: Schedule view only: how far ahead the list goes. (With rooms set, the Later list shows as much of the next day as fits.)

maxDuration.title: Hide long sessions in progress (minutes)
maxDuration.description: Schedule view only: sessions in progress that last longer than this (free play, open rooms) are left out of the list. 0 shows them all.

pageSeconds.title: Seconds per page
pageSeconds.description: When the schedule or the rooms don't fit on one screen, how long each page shows.

showDescription.title: Show description
showDescription.description: For a single room, show the current session's description.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York. Empty uses the player's time zone.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: super2027: the Super MAGFest 2027 theme art (logo, crest background, divider, name tags and hearts). plain: dark, no art.

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.description: Empty uses the theme's (gold for super2027).

background.title: Background colour
background.description: Behind the theme art; empty uses the theme's. For plain, a transparent colour (rgba(...)) shows the layers behind.
